title: 23.23. Saṅkiliṭṭhattika, Kusalattika
note: Pāli only: every English translation of the Abhidhamma is still under copyright, so no English can be shown yet. A free translation will be added if one becomes available.

verses.t: Nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṁ nakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā cha …pe… avigate cha.
Nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṁ naakusalaṁ dhammaṁ paccayā saṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā tīṇi …pe… avigate tīṇi.
Nasaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesikaṁ naabyākataṁ dhammaṁ paṭicca asaṅkiliṭṭhasaṅkilesiko abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. (Saṅkhittaṁ.) Hetuyā cha, adhipatiyā cha …pe… avigate cha.
